# betterado_release_definition_permissions (Resource)

Manages Azure DevOps security permissions for a classic release definition.
Permissions are applied at the definition level and control who can view, edit,
queue, approve, and manage the release.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Map of String)
- `principal` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `release_definition_id` (Number)
- `replace` (Boolean)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
